overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The notice's single 6:00 PM masthead time was outweighed by repeated 5:00 PM and 5:01 PM listings, so the public was not likely confused. The AG only encouraged more care.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board held an executive session at 5:01 PM though the notice's masthead listed the meeting time as 6:00 PM.
allegations.key_passage: Because the notice posted for the October 16, 2025, meeting listed a 5:00 P.M. start time in multiple locations, and, indeed, the meeting began at that time, we find it unlikely that any member of the public was genuinely confused by the one 6:00 P.M. notation listed on the notice.
